dct_description_sm: This dataset contains monthly, biweekly and event samples from watercourses located across the Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) jurisdiction by LTVCA staff. The dataset includes additional samples collected from Provincial Water Quality Monitoring Network (PWQMN) locations outside of the standard PWQMN schedule (typically April to November) as well as additional priority locations. This data set excludes the PWQMN data that is collected during the same time periods.
dct_title_s: Lower Thames Valley Conservation Authority (LTVCA) - Laboratory Water Quality Data
